admin_panel.off_default_the_binge_watch_button_is_hi: Off (default): the binge-watch button is hidden from the host's control strip entirely; episodes never auto-advance.
admin_panel.on_the_host_gets_a_binge_on_off_pill_in_: On: the host gets a "Binge ON/OFF" pill in the control strip while an Episode is playing. When the host turns it on, the next episode in the same season auto-plays after the current one ends (with a countdown that any user can cancel). Movies and standalone items never auto-advance, regardless of this setting.
admin_panel.turning_this_off_mid_session_hides_the_b: Turning this off mid-session hides the button in every active party and cancels any countdown that's already running.
admin_panel.seconds_shown_to_the_room_before_the_nex: Seconds shown to the room before the next episode auto-plays. Any user can hit Cancel during this window. 4 seconds is the 1.x default; shorter feels snappier, longer gives more time to grab the remote.
admin_panel.tick_a_resolution_to_expose_it_in_the_pe: Tick a resolution to expose it in the per-user quality dropdown; the bitrate checkboxes only appear once the resolution is enabled and let you trim the list further. 360p / 240p / 144p are resolution-only (no bitrate choices).

admin_panel.login_hint: When on, creating a party requires {provider} credentials and the creator becomes host. When off, anyone can create; any member can later log in to host. Browsing always needs a host with a valid session.
admin_panel.transcode_off_hint: Off (default): {provider} decides per-source. h264 sources within the quality bitrate cap get stream-copied (no re-encode, low CPU/GPU on the {provider} host).
admin_panel.transcode_on_hint: On: every HLS request carries {flag}, so {provider} always re-encodes. This produces uniform 6-second segments that HLS.js can seek into cleanly at any position.
admin_panel.transcode_seek_hint: Turn this on if you see large seeks (Skip Intro, dragging the progress bar a long distance) restart the video from the beginning, or if stream-copied content stalls during seeking. Cost: extra CPU/GPU load on the {provider} server.
admin_panel.quality_auto_hint: Auto is always available unless Force Transcode is on; in that mode it would conflict with always-transcode and is replaced by the 1080p / 10 Mbps preset as the safe default. Bitrate buckets mirror {provider}'s own table (tuned for software-encode safety on the low end).
